title: Founder programmes an early-stage Indian founder is likely to compare
release: Compiled by hand from each programme's public pages

programmes.name: Razorpay Rize
programmes.leadOffer: Company registration, founder communities and YC application help
programmes.detail: Registration for Pvt Ltd, LLP and OPC. Three communities: Tech+, D2C+, Xport+. Rize for YC (application reviews, mock interviews), Pitch Perfect, Razorpay Ventures.
programmes.entryBar: Open to early-stage founders in India

programmes.name: Stripe Atlas
programmes.detail: Delaware C corporation or LLC, tax ID, founder equity paperwork, $2,500 in Stripe credits. US$100 a year after the first year.
programmes.entryBar: Anyone, including founders outside the US

programmes.name: AWS Activate
programmes.detail: Founders tier: starts at $1,000, up to $5,000, for self-funded startups. Portfolio tier: up to $200,000, needs an ID from an accelerator, investor or other Activate Provider.
programmes.entryBar: Low for the small tier; a backer for the large one
programmes.meetsFounder: After there is a product to host

programmes.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
programmes.detail: Reported as up to $2,000 for unfunded startups and up to $200,000 over two years for startups with institutional funding.
programmes.entryBar: Low for the small tier; institutional funding for the large one
programmes.meetsFounder: After there is a product to host

programmes.name: Microsoft for Startups
programmes.detail: Open to private companies building a software product; no investor needed to join. Larger credit tiers are reported to need funding, customers or an accelerator.
programmes.entryBar: Low to join; traction for larger tiers
programmes.meetsFounder: After there is a product to host
programmes.verified: official page for eligibility; secondary sources for tiers

programmes.name: Zoho for Startups
programmes.detail: Reported as ₹1 lakh on approval plus ₹86,000 for hosting email with Zoho; up to ₹3 lakh for DPIIT-recognised startups. For new Zoho users only.
programmes.entryBar: DPIIT recognition or a partner incubator
programmes.verified: secondary sources, including the Startup India partner page

read: Four of the six lead with credits. Credits are easy to compare and easy to match, so those programmes compete on the size of the number.
Rize and Stripe Atlas are the two that meet a founder before the company exists, and both are run by payments companies. Atlas forms US companies; Rize forms Indian ones.
That makes the first finding on this site a business question as well as a data one: Rize's most successful YC founders end up listed in San Francisco, which is where Atlas operates.
